Plot an association scan

Source: R/gwas-methods.R
plot.indri_gwas.Rd

A Manhattan plot (-log10(p) along the genome) or a QQ plot (observed against expected -log10(p) under the null), drawn with ggplot2 and returned as a ggplot object to print, save or extend.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'indri_gwas'
plot(
  x,
  type = c("manhattan", "qq"),
  which = c("joint", "dominance", "gxe", "empirical"),
  trait = NULL,
  threshold = NULL,
  highlight = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An indri_gwas scan.

type

"manhattan" or "qq".

which

The p-values to draw: "joint" (pvalues, the default), "dominance" (pvalues_dominance), "gxe" (pvalues_gxe) or "empirical" (pvalues_empirical).

trait

For single-trait scans, the trait to draw; NULL (the default) draws each SNP's smallest p-value over traits, adjusted when the scan was (pvalues_adjust). The QQ plot of a single-trait scan uses every SNP and trait when trait is NULL.

threshold

Significance line on the Manhattan plot, as a p-value; defaults to Bonferroni over the SNPs drawn (0.05 / M). NA for none.

highlight

Names of SNPs to mark and label.

...

Unused.

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

The Manhattan plot places SNPs by chrom and pos from snp_info when both are there, chromosomes end to end; otherwise in column order. SNPs with NA p-values (monomorphic, or without a dominance estimate) are left out.

See also

indri_gwas()
